verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents an official MCP Server that connects it to any AI tool via the Model Context Protocol, with a dedicated docs page describing authentication by sign-in or API key. A probe also confirms an official repository at mendableai/firecrawl-mcp-server. Missing for 10: detail on the exposed tool set and transport/setup per client, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
